title: Backend Core Version Contract Consumer Hardening
summary: Open the Backend-owned consumer hardening lane after Core published a version-surface retirement inventory. Backend must consume or compare against Core-owned version capability facts without untracked copies, preserve Backend revision and persistence ownership, and classify/delete any copied Core version facts found in scope.
expectedOutput: A Backend-owned implementation patch or bounded blocker that prevents Core version capability drift, keeps revision/persistence behavior Backend-owned, removes or records copied Core version facts, and returns fresh Backend evidence for Project Control.
riskSummary: Backend broad truth remains unknown; changing capability reporting can break Editor migration decisions or Backend revision gates if the lane bypasses Core contracts, copies stale facts, or treats Core migration-target parsing as Backend persistence readiness.
